tasks.description: Task editor records. Completed tasks remain stored and can be reopened.
tasks.documentId: Positive numeric task ID as a string, equal to id. Allocate max existing ID + 1 and check for collisions in a transaction; never overwrite another task.

title.description: Nonempty task title, fewer than 500 characters.

parentId.description: Parent task ID; null for a top-level task.

sourceId.description: External reference such as todoist:<id> or muse:goal_<id>.

next.description: YYYY-MM-DD date, place name, or empty string. Not a Firestore timestamp.

aiAction.description: Instruction for an AI; clear to an empty string after handling.

order.description: Ascending position within priority; preserve manual order. New rows normally append at max order + 1000.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation time. Preserve on updates.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 last-write time. Set on every update.

updatedBy.description: Writer identifier; the editor currently uses the Firebase Auth UID.

done.description: Reversible completion checkbox. Set true or false; do not delete completed tasks. Missing means false.

tasks.validation: Expected contract, not full rules enforcement. Current rules enforce id matching on create, immutable id on update, title length 1-499, and at most 30 top-level fields. Unknown fields are allowed.
tasks.notes: Editor lists all records, including groups and completed tasks. Do not silently sort by title or date. The deployed widget does not yet exclude done tasks.

users.description: Directory of Firebase Auth accounts, including accounts not yet authorized.

email.description: Email at account creation, or null.

name.description: Display name at account creation, or null.

users.validation: Descriptive only; currently no field validation in rules.
users.notes: Populated by registerUser and an initial backfill. Later Auth profile changes/deletions are not automatically synchronized. Labels are not proof of identity. Directory presence grants no access. Member edits do not change Firebase Auth.

access.description: Membership granting database access and membership-management privileges.
access.documentId: Firebase Auth UID of the account being authorized.
access.validation: Document existence grants membership. No fields are required; an empty document is sufficient.
access.notes: All members are trusted administrators of app data and can grant/revoke membership. Create access/{UID} to grant access; delete it to revoke. Do not store credentials here. This does not grant Firebase IAM or Auth-administration permissions.

collections.description: Discoverable catalog of app collections and their expected document formats.
collections.documentId: Collection name, for example tasks, users, access, or collections.

documentId.description: Document ID format and allocation instructions.

fields.description: Field name to descriptor: type (string), required (boolean), optional default (JSON value), values (array of allowed values), and description (string). Missing optional defaults do not imply a stored value.

validation.description: What is actually enforced, versus merely expected.

collections.validation: Descriptive only; currently no field validation in rules.
collections.notes: Readable and writable by all approved members, not anonymous users. Keep live catalog documents, repository database/collections.json, app code, and agent guidance synchronized when collections or fields change. Excludes private backend credential storage.
